title: Developmental structure formation in Organica 1: a preregistered account of what the engine grows, and what it does not
description: A preregistered empirical account of whether developmental structure emerges in Organica 1, a minimal engine that grows a graph of typed structural candidates across sleep cycles. The paper reports the displacement and preservation indices over a preregistered support-ratio sweep, the failed criteria and the adjacent-difference diagnostic behind them, and an acquisition benchmark that was rebuilt after an endpoint audit and then stopped at its own gate. Negative results are reported as results: the belief-revision comparison against simple baselines came out reversed on all three task families, and the one measured cross-domain transfer result was negative. Every quantitative claim is checked mechanically against the committed artifact it was taken from.
notes: Files: the manuscript as PDF, the manuscript source (Markdown), and the five figures as PDF. The supporting evidence artifacts are in the software record for v0.9.0 and in the repository.
